paragraphs.en: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
paragraphs.zh: 开发者优先的错误追踪与性能监控

paragraphs.en: Users and logs provide clues. Sentry provides answers.
paragraphs.zh: 用户和日志提供线索，Sentry 给出答案。

paragraphs.en: Sentry is the debugging platform that helps every developer detect, trace, and fix issues. Code breaks, fix it faster.
paragraphs.zh: Sentry 是一个调试平台，帮助每一位开发者检测、追踪并修复问题。 代码出错了？更快修复它。
